subplayer.release_notes: v1.3.2: PITCH knob restored (master + all 16 per-pad pitch params, -24..+24 semitones, default 0). Old sessions keep their pitch values. Knob values still carry when scrolling the bank, CHOKE stays global and ON, UPDATE button wired to the live feed.

lock.release_notes: First release. Automatic vocal alignment: always listening, captures on vocal, aligns dubs to the lead. Never mutes your live vocal.

looplab.release_notes: v1.0.1: Fixed AU crash on load (FL Studio EAccessViolation). The voice engine held a dead stack-local channel array; it now copies pointers into per-voice storage. Regression test added. Melody-loop player: 16 waveform slices on MIDI C1-E2, tempo sync, key detection, pitch to project key, reference-only folder scan, zero latency. UPDATE button wired to this feed.

hub.release_notes: v1.0.1: Hub can now update itself from inside the Hub (UPDATE HUB button). Fixed downloader stall that aborted every download after 64 KB.
